**Orbweaver 1.0.2 fixes sessions that went missing on your other machines.** It contains this one fix and nothing else since 1.0.1.

## What's fixed

- **Your other machines now see sessions from every Claude Code profile you've set up.** Orbweaver only offered sessions from the accounts it had listed back when Remote Control was removed. A profile added afterwards under **Settings → Claude Code** was never shared with your other machines. If all of a machine's sessions ran under that profile, the others saw nothing from it, and nothing said why. All of your configured Claude Code profiles are shared now. A profile you add is picked up within seconds, without a restart.
- **Settings now tells you when sessions aren't being shared.** If a machine has live sessions under a folder it isn't sharing, **Settings → Other machines** says so in one line and tells you where to add that folder. The line appears once another machine is connected.

## Upgrading

Install over 1.0.1 as usual. You don't need to change anything: profiles you already added under Settings → Claude Code are shared as soon as the new version starts.

- **macOS:** as with every upgrade, re-grant Local Network in System Settings → Privacy & Security if your other machines or OpenClaw stop connecting.

## Known limitations

- The Settings line only updates while another machine is connected.
- A profile folder that can't be read is recorded in the diagnostic log, not shown in Settings.

## Which file do I want

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `Orbweaver-1.0.2-osx-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Orbweaver-1.0.2-osx-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11, 64-bit | `Orbweaver-1.0.2-win-x64-setup.exe` |

The `OrbweaverSpeech-*.zip` files are the optional neural speech engine. The app downloads the one it needs, so you don't need to.
